name: Andhra Pradesh

topAttractions.name: Charminar
topAttractions.description: A historic mosque and one of the most recognizable landmarks in India, built in 1591 by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah.

topAttractions.name: Ramappa Temple
topAttractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the finest examples of Kakatiya architecture, built in the 12th century.

topAttractions.name: Araku Valley
topAttractions.description: A scenic hill station with breathtaking views, waterfalls, and trekking trails, known for its coffee plantations and indigenous tribes.

bestTimeToVisit: The best time to visit Andhra Pradesh is from October to February, when the weather is mild and pleasant.
culturalFact: Andhra Pradesh is home to the ancient and revered tradition of Bhakti movement, which emerged in the 12th century and emphasized devotion to a personal deity.

hiddenGem.name: Kolleru Lake
hiddenGem.description: The second-largest freshwater lake in India, known for its migratory birds and scenic beauty.

relatedFestival: The Bonalu festival, celebrated in July-August, is a significant festival in Andhra Pradesh, where devotees worship the goddess Mahakali with traditional dances and offerings.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps from the Ramoji Film City in Hyderabad, you might be interested in exploring the state's vibrant film industry and attending a movie shoot!
